summary: AIR Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of AIR Global PLC (Nasdaq: AIIR), announced a proposed offering of U.S. dollar-denominated Rule 144A/Regulation S senior unsecured notes, guaranteed on a senior basis by AIR and certain subsidiaries. Proceeds will repay its term loan and revolving credit facility and fund general corporate purposes, including fees. Pricing, coupon and offering price remain subject to market conditions; no board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation; watch pricing, leverage impact and execution risk.
